t: DEWALT Bevel Edge 6 piece chisel set contains durable hand tools for precise material removal across various woodworking projects. Each chisel features a hardened and tempered steel blade for prolonged edge retention and a bevelled edge design, allowing easy access into tight corners and edges. An ergonomically designed acetate handle offers comfortable grip and control, complemented by a steel strike cap for reliable striking. The lacquered blades ensure corrosion protection, extending tool life. Includes 6, 12, 19, 25, 32 and 38mm chisels, ideal for professional woodworkers, carpenters, and DIY enthusiasts.
